generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Detect missing, conflicting or unclear requirements; generate the minimum necessary clarification questions; determine whether the intent is ready for planning.

contract.purpose_user_function: Detect blocking ambiguity and decide whether enough information exists for planning, producing minimum clarification needs.
contract.valid_inputs: Normalized/raw intent, goals, scope, constraints, terms, acceptance conditions, conflicts, and missing required fields.
contract.expected_outputs: Ready/not-ready signal plus unresolved ambiguity/missing-field list and clarification prompts or fallback route.
contract.state_side_effects: May write/update intake artifact; should not dispatch execution when blocking ambiguity remains.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Conflicting or missing goal/scope/approval/success criteria must block readiness; nonblocking uncertainty may be recorded.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Not found as a dedicated clarification generator/readiness engine. Current intent rewrite exposes structured fields but behavior is partial.
contract.success_evidence: Future proof should show blocking ambiguity prevents planning and generated questions are minimal and answerable; current direct proof is absent.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: complete; missing goal; ambiguous term; conflicting constraints; missing approval; nonblocking uncertainty; answer applied.
